newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator steady on 556c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator steady on 556c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator was steady on 556 cents a kg clean after sales on Wednesday in Newcastle, Adelaide and Launceston, Wool International (WI) said in its market report.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19 micron indicator slightly cheaper and 20/21m up to 1.0 percent cheaper.
The 22m category was unchanged, while 23/25/26m were up to 1.0 percent dearer and 24m 0.5 percent dearer.
In merino skirtings, 19m was generally unchanged while 20/21m were 1.0 percent dearer.

In crossbreds, 27/30m were slightly dearer, 28m was 1.0 percent dearer, 29m 0.5 percent dearer and 31m 0.5 percent cheaper. In cardings, lambs were unchanged and locks and crutchings generally unchanged, it said.
WI said Japanese, Chinese and Italian interests were principal buyers and were well supported by most sectors of the trade. Of 32,058 bales offered, 10.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in the same centres with about 27,200 bales to be offered.
